name: Black RAF R.8010B Electric Stove Hot Plate and Cooker with 1000W Power, Thermostat, and Uniform Heating
description:
Introducing the White RAF Electric Stove & Hot Plate R.8010B — a compact, powerful, and versatile cooker designed for everyday use. With 1000 watts of power and uniform heating, it ensures consistent cooking results. The non-stick surface allows for easy cleaning, while the auto-thermostat and overheat protection provide safety and peace of mind. Featuring a single cooking plate and simple operation, it’s perfect for simmering, sautéing, frying, or boiling with ease.
Key Features:
 Model: RAF R.8010B Electric Stove & Hot Plate
 Power: 1000W
 Single cooking plate design
 On/off indicator light for user convenience
 Auto-thermostat for precise temperature control
 Overheat protection for added safety
 Non-stick coating for effortless cleanup
 Compact size suitable for small kitchens and travel use
How to Use:
 Plug in the stove and place it on a stable surface
 Turn on power switch and select desired heat level
 Place cookware on the hot plate and start cooking
 Switch off after use and allow to cool before cleaning
 Wipe with a damp cloth for easy maintenance
Safety Information:
 Use only on a stable, heat-resistant surface
 Do not touch the hot plate directly while in use
 Unplug after use and allow cooling before storage
 Keep out of reach of children
Package Includes:
 1 × White RAF R.8010B Electric Stove & Hot Plate
 1 × User Manual
